mapper.insert: insert into user_address ( user_id, contact_name, contact_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, latitude, longitude, building_type, floor, is_default) values (#{userId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{buildingType}, #{floor}, #{isDefault})
mapper.select: select * from user_address where user_id = #{userId} order by is_default desc, create_time desc
select * from user_address where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1 limit 1
mapper.update: update user_address set is_default = 0 where user_id = #{userId}
